Plix is performing imitation behavior: it stretches its arms upwards, then bends at the elbows, repeating this action in a rhythmic manner, similar to the swaying of tree branches in the wind and a person reaching for an apple.

[Question]
What is Plix possibly imitating?

B. A robot performing maintenance work.
